overview: Unified (selected candidate unified-v11, preset "unified_v11") is a clock-free, constant-learning-rate ParticleGAN formulation that unites all four GAN laws with strictly zero torch.autograd.grad, zero torch.linalg.svd/svdvals, zero torch.linalg.eigh/eigvalsh, and zero torch.linalg.pinv across every forward, backward, penalty, transport, conditional fiber bank, prior, and optimizer path. It combines streaming Laguerre-Pythagorean prototype quantization and orthogonal pullback covariance isometry (Law 1), a first-order Born-Infeld secant critic regularizer with zero-mean logit gauge (Law 2), scale-invariant k=4 density-ratio orphan macro-transport and a zero-eigh cyclic-Jacobi cross-batch conditional fiber operator bank (Law 3), and fused Z=[X,Y] Quintic Tikhonov polar equilibration with dynamic-1e-38 Marchenko-Pastur scaling, realized generator pushforward secant trust, and strictly zero-autograd.grad / zero-pinv analytic non-ascent direction_blend projection (Law 4). It is the provisional public research default (DEFAULT_RECIPE = "unified_v11") in 0.11.0; Forge screening calibration remains provisional (BLOCKED under criteria-v1.json) and remaining failures (staggered100 / staggered100_14k, grid100_res16_tanh, five_word_joint_hold, model_ddgan_bimodal_chain, model_ae_ddgan_gaussian_chain, interp_img_patch_shift, interp_saddle_barycentric, and 12 unimplemented Tier-4 stretch hosts) stay explicitly disclosed.
symbols: $G$ is the generator, $D$ the raw-score critic, $P$ the task prior with $M$ locations in $\mathbb R^{d_z}$, $x$ a real batch of size $B_r$, $z\sim P$ a latent batch, and $y=G(z)$ the generated batch of size $B_f$. $r_{\mathrm{loc}}(y_j)=d_{k=4}(y_j,X_{\mathrm{fake}})/d_{k=4}(y_j,Y_{\mathrm{real}}\setminus\{y_j\})$ is the scale-invariant local orphan density ratio, $(W_t,S_c,S_y,S_{cc},S_{cy},S_{yy})$ plus a paired-context FIFO ring ($M=384$) form the zero-eigh conditional fiber operator bank, $Z=[X,Y]\in\mathbb R^{m\times(n+m)}$ is the fused Tikhonov-augmented polar matrix, and $\Delta D_{\mathrm{sec}}$ is the first-order finite-difference / fwAD critic secant slope.
pseudocode: Choose an adversarial loss and constant learning rates (lr=0.014, d_lr_mult=1.5, prior_lr_mult=2.9).
Sample real x and latent z from the task prior P; compute y = G(z).
Evaluate first-order Born-Infeld secant critic penalty (no torch.autograd.grad) on real/fake/chord perturbations plus zero-mean logit gauge and update instance-bound thermal scale.
Backpropagate critic adversarial loss + secant penalty and step D via UnifiedV11EquilibratedOptimizer (dynamic-1e-38 MP scaling + fused Z=[X,Y] Quintic Tikhonov polar, zero SVD).

With D fixed, recompute differentiable y = G(z) and evaluate generator loss: Sinkhorn-debiased relativistic + Born-Infeld transport + scale-invariant k=4 density-ratio orphan macro-transport + core-ball Burg covariance + zero-eigh cyclic-Jacobi conditional fiber operator matching (when conditioned) + UnifiedV11PriorRegularizer.

When multiple protected objectives exist (e.g. residual_student or AE/VAE), evaluate protected normals via standard .backward(retain_graph=True) and project via closed-form 1x1/2x2 zero-pinv non-ascent direction_blend.
Step G, trainable prior P (with Laguerre-Pythagorean pullback isometry), and encoder E when present using constant learning rates and realized generator pushforward secant trust.

training_details.loss: Selectable non-saturating logistic (selected configuration) augmented with Sinkhorn-debiased relativistic transport, scale-invariant k=4 density-ratio orphan macro-transport, core-ball Burg covariance matching, and zero-eigh cross-batch conditional fiber operator matching (IMQ-CMMD + whitened stratum mean/covariance + paired-context ring local covariance) on conditioned hosts.
training_details.optimizer: UnifiedV11EquilibratedOptimizer (optimizer_family="unified_v11_equil", zero momentum, smoothing 0.0061, BF16 channels-last conv training, direction_blend constraint geometry): dynamic-1e-38 Marchenko-Pastur scaling, fused Z=[X,Y] 5-step Quintic Tikhonov polar (FP32 for m<64, BF16 for 64<=m<=128, zero torch.linalg.svd/eigh/pinv), realized generator pushforward secant trust band, and closed-form 1x1/2x2 analytic non-ascent projection.
training_details.learning_rates: Strictly constant (`lr_floor=1.0`, `network_lr_floor=1.0`): global LR $0.014$, critic multiplier $1.5$, and prior multiplier $2.9$ (`prior_reg=0.02`).
training_details.gradient_clipping: None. Step equilibration operates through dynamic-$10^{-38}$ scale normalization, fused Quintic Tikhonov polar projection, and realized pushforward secant trust without hard parameter clipping.
training_details.critic_penalty: First-order Born-Infeld secant critic regularizer (`critic_formulation="unified_v11"`, `ebi_beta=12.0`, `reg_coeff=1.0`, `reg_kappa=1.0`, zero `torch.autograd.grad`) evaluated along endpoints and transport chords with zero-mean logit gauge and state-driven thermal settling.
training_details.damping_and_guards: Instance-bound checkpointed step record carrying shock-filtered transport EMA, conditional fiber bank sufficient statistics and 384-pair FIFO ring, worst-stratum operator-gated conditional cooling, thermal-safe precision gating, and per-group depth accounting; zero global state and zero step counters.
training_details.noise: No scheduled additive critic-input or generator-output training noise (`input_noise_std=0.0`, `output_noise_std=0.0`). Task-declared MoG intrinsic sigma is preserved.
training_details.averaging: Generator EMA decay=$0$ and serve_average=$0$; all evaluations score live unaveraged weights.

configuration_notes: Unified combines the four independently isolated GAN laws (T1 prior topology & coupling, T2 first-order secant critic, T3 RGDT macro-transport & causal isolation, T4 Nash equilibration & deep-architecture transport) plus Round-3's conditional fiber operator matching into one zero-SVD / zero-eigh / zero-pinv / zero-autograd.grad global recipe.

All bank tensors, FIFO rings, low-discrepancy phases, and thermal scalars live exclusively on instance-bound state dicts and travel bit-for-bit across fresh-process checkpoint save/load with tamper rejection.

Honest governance disclosure (AGENTS.md): tuning budget spans 11 hand-declared unified-v1..v11 candidate cards across Round 2-4 studies (no registered grid search). Forge calibration acceptance remains BLOCKED under configs/forge/calibration/criteria-v1.json (see reports/forge/studies/r3-calibration-holdout.md and reports/forge/calibration/r3-calibration-holdout.json). Remaining honest numerical failures on unified-v11 (staggered100 / staggered100_14k, grid100_res16_tanh, five_word_joint_hold, model_ddgan_bimodal_chain, model_ae_ddgan_gaussian_chain, interp_img_patch_shift, interp_saddle_barycentric) and 12 unimplemented Tier-4 stretch hosts remain explicitly visible. For a compact <900-LOC zero-Newton-Schulz fast core (55.50 ms/step on DCGAN r256), see the separate Minimal family (preset="minimal").
One global trainer configuration supplies every displayed result across Tier 1-4; task-owned architectures, priors, initializations, budgets, and gates remain fixed.
